metaDescription: Treasure Hunters is live on Crossbones Isle. This map still loads Fortnite-API’s live dump (Override island as of 1 Nov 2026). Pirate Shop Access is a BR chest prize, not a pin.
title: Fortnite Interactive Map

howTitle: How this Fortnite map tool works
howBody: This interactive Fortnite map loads the current Battle Royale minimap and places markers using live POI coordinates. Toggle Spawns layers for Extraction Sites, vaults, Sprite chests, chests, vehicles, reboot vans, and more — or filter named drops by contest and loot.
howLiveBody: Real in-game map imagery from Fortnite-API — currently still the previous Override dump until that feed ships Crossbones Isle.
howExtractBody: Diamond markers for Sprite extract pads near major POIs (quiet vs hot traffic).
howPoiBody: Click whatever names Fortnite-API currently lists. Crossbones Isle pins (Arlong Park, Windmill Village, The $.$. Rocky) land when that dump updates.
howLootBody: Sort hot drops, balanced landings, and quiet edge POIs.
extractBodyBefore: Spawn layers on this page still ring around Override-era POI names that Fortnite-API still lists (Lifty Lodge, Sunken Shores, Wonkeeland, Golden Grove). Names that already left that dump (Frosted Flats, Sinister Strip, Calamari Canyon) drop off silently. Treasure Hunters hunt loop is Wanted Posters → Sprite Treasure Maps → buried Sprite Chests on Crossbones Isle — those pins are not invented here. Sprite extract steps:
extractLink: how to extract Sprites (may be stale on Crossbones Isle)
locationsBody: Treasure Hunters’ live island is Crossbones Isle. Until Fortnite-API lists those names, the markers below still describe the previous Override dump. Use in-game labels for Arlong Park, Windmill Village, and The $.$. Rocky.
hotBody: Lifty Lodge, Heatwave Harbor, Green Hill Zone, Reality’s Reign — high loot on the dump this page still loads. On Crossbones Isle, treat The $.$. Rocky and Arlong Park as the contested names instead.
balancedBody: Wonkeeland, Golden Grove, Shaken Sanctuary, Chopped Shop — solid chests on the dump. On Crossbones Isle, Windmill Village is the named quiet-town analog until we have coords.
edgeBody: Cluster Coast, Sunken Shores, Stone Sanctum — quieter loot on the dump. Crossbones Isle edge names are not pinned until Fortnite-API publishes them.
landingTitle: Best Fortnite landing spots by goal
landingFightBody: Drop contested named locations under the bus path. You will die more often, but you learn loot speed, first fights, and third-party timing faster.
landingRankedBody: Prefer balanced or edge POIs, leave with mobility, and rotate early. Surviving to top 10 usually beats greed-looting one more chest.
landingSquadsBody: Land in the same building cluster, split floors, and meet on a marked point. Split-landing across a whole city creates free 1v3s.

faqs.q1: What is the current Fortnite map in Treasure Hunters?
faqs.a1: Treasure Hunters (v43.00, 1 Nov 2026) uses Crossbones Isle, an 80-player Battle Royale island. Epic named Arlong Park, Windmill Village, and The $.$. Rocky. This tool’s pins follow Fortnite-API, which as of 1 Nov 2026 still lists the previous Override island.
faqs.q2: Where is the Pirate Shop on the Fortnite map?
faqs.a2: It is not a map pin. Pirate Shop Access is a rare Battle Royale chest prize. Open chests, watch for the unlock MOTD, then claim Item Shop rows during the 14-day windows.
faqs.q3: Where should I land in Fortnite for the best loot?
faqs.a3: On Crossbones Isle, headline drops are Arlong Park, Windmill Village, and The $.$. Rocky. Until Fortnite-API ships those coordinates, the pins here still match the previous island dump — trust in-game labels.
faqs.q4: How do I use this interactive Fortnite map?
faqs.a4: Use the left sidebar: pick Battle Royale, search spawns/POIs, toggle spawn layers (vaults, Sprite chests, chests, vehicles, reboot vans, and more), Named Locations / Landmarks, then filter drops by hot / balanced / edge. Click markers for tips. Spawn pins are POI-anchored planning markers. OG, Reload, and Blitz maps are still coming soon.
faqs.q5: Does this Fortnite map update every season?
faqs.a5: The minimap image and coordinates load from live Fortnite-API data, so named locations refresh when that dump updates. Treasure Hunters launched 1 Nov 2026; Crossbones Isle pins land here when Fortnite-API lists them.
